explication: Ars0n Framework v2 is a bug-bounty workflow platform that guides authorized target testing, wraps reconnaissance and scanning tools, and retains results for attack-surface analysis. Its main user journey runs from target and scope setup through asset discovery, URL/endpoint work, scanning, and review; learning guidance and browser-assisted capture support that journey. The repository also exposes workflows through an MCP server and includes a target-behavior probe. Edges reflect README statements and shown source references; some subsystem connections remain unverified because their wiring was not sampled.
